facts.text: Southeastern Louisiana University runs a rental textbook system where students rent books for a flat fee of $60 per course rather than purchasing them.

sources.title: Textbook Rental - Southeastern Louisiana University
sources.quote: At Southeastern, students RENT their textbooks instead of having to buy them! Textbook Rental provides Southeastern students an economical alternative to purchasing textbooks.

sources.title: Textbook Rental - Southeastern Louisiana University
sources.quote: The current rental fee for a course which has a rental book is $60 regardless of the number of textbooks required for a course.
